coaching.summary: The core tension is between Tech Lead Hired driving Technical Architecture Quality and faster decision-making versus Two Mid-Level Developers Hired delivering more raw coding throughput but introducing Team Coordination Overhead and a longer Time to Productivity — both of which directly threaten the 6-month deadline. The biggest unmodelled risk is that neither hire profile has been validated against the actual AI feature backlog size or existing team capacity.

bias_signals.detail: The brief frames this as a binary choice between two hire profiles without considering phased hiring, contractor augmentation, or reallocation of existing team capacity.

elements_considered_but_excluded: External AI talent market tightness considered but excluded as it affects both options equally and would not change ranking
Phased hire option considered but excluded from graph as it lacks a distinct intervention profile on current factors — surfaced in coaching instead

strengthen_items.label: Hybrid or phased hire
strengthen_items.detail: Hiring one mid-level developer now and deferring the second hire after 3 months could reduce coordination risk while preserving budget flexibility.

strengthen_items.label: Backlog size as constraint
strengthen_items.detail: The AI feature backlog volume and complexity is the decisive missing input — without it, the model cannot distinguish whether raw throughput or architectural direction is the binding constraint.
